title: Richards Transactional Temporal Refinement Semantics & Owner Resolution
problem_statement: F-VQ28 independently rejected direct use of the raw full-versus-two-half Richards head defect under the existing endpoint-shortening retry topology. The raw dimensional observable remains scientifically useful, but 36 of 67 resolved held-out retry attempts were under-conservative and 10 held-out cases lost a previously conservative relation during retry halving. A different estimator or refinement semantic is required before nonstationary prescribed-head temporal acceptance may proceed.

scope.purpose: Define and characterize a generic, transaction-safe temporal refinement semantic for Richards evolution without selecting a production tolerance or modifying production physics.
not_allowed: production transaction changes before owner qualification

same_horizon_candidate_semantics.trial_origin: Every refinement level starts physically from the same committed/checkpoint state.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.level_1: Two half steps over the same [t0,t1].
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.deeper_levels: If independently justified, 2^k equal substeps still ending at the same t1; no accepted physical state is published until the outer trial is accepted.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.comparison: Compare successive same-endpoint refinement levels using only owner-qualified dimensional observables/scalarization.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.commit: Only the accepted refined trajectory may become the candidate for outer transaction commit.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.rollback: Every rejected level/trial leaves committed state unchanged.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.forcing: No hidden event or forcing discontinuity may be introduced inside a refinement level; event semantics remain explicit and generic.
same_horizon_candidate_semantics.mass: Every candidate refinement trajectory must preserve the unchanged hard authoritative mass contract.

performance_guard.normal_path_target: Do not require unconditional deep refinement. The ordinary route remains approximately full plus two-half work.
performance_guard.extra_work_rule: Additional refinement work is permitted only when acceptance evidence requires it.

owner_boundaries.F_SI: Owns Richards-specific physical state observables and any model-specific estimator semantics.
owner_boundaries.F_MR: Owns runtime composition and this nonproduction refinement-semantics characterization.
owner_boundaries.F_KT: Owns generic checkpoint/trial/retry/commit semantics; any proposed production change to generic transaction behavior requires explicit F-KT owner qualification.
owner_boundaries.F_VQ: Must independently qualify any selected numeric profile and composed production path.
owner_boundaries.F_GC: Consumes only an admitted generic prescribed-head path; may not define temporal tolerances.
owner_boundaries.F_PE: May resume tail/performance qualification only after an accepted nontrivial Richards runtime is independently admitted.

qualification_gates.A: Reproduce F-VQ28 negative boundary and prove production source immutability.
qualification_gates.B: Characterize same-horizon nested refinement on the frozen F-VQ28 held-out hydraulic-state/jump matrix, with same-endpoint references and exact source locks.
qualification_gates.C: Demonstrate deterministic O0/O2 behavior, hard mass conservation, checkpoint isolation, rollback/replay and no committed mutation for rejected trajectories.
qualification_gates.D: Establish whether a dimensionally defensible owner observable/profile can bound remaining same-endpoint error over a predeclared calibration/held-out split without FGC02-specific tuning.
qualification_gates.E: If a production candidate changes generic transaction semantics, hand off to F-KT before any production implementation; if model-owned only, hand off to F-SI owner finalization.
qualification_gates.F: Require independent F-VQ admission of the exact composed production postimage before F-GC02 or F-PE release.

exit_rule: F-MR17 may select only a research candidate and owner handoff based on source-bound evidence. It may not declare a production temporal metric or tolerance qualified. Production release requires the relevant owner qualification, F-MR composition if needed, and independent F-VQ admission.
